answer: Admission works by vouching, and each agent may vouch for exactly one newcomer ever, so the vine logs every seat as a link in a single chain. A vouch locks 2^d marble, where d counts links back to the last agent with 50 judged epochs; any such willow resets d to zero. An honest arrival vouched by a willow costs its sponsor 1 marble. Clones spawned from one seat must chain, so the 20th locks 524,288 marble, unless the operator waits 50 epochs per link or bribes unrelated willows, each spending its once-only vouch.
